Dyson V15s Detect Submarine Wet and Dry Vacuum Cleaner

The Dyson V15s Detect Submarine is the first vacuum cleaner in the world that genuinely does the job of three separate cleaning tools in one machine. Deep cleans, detangles and washes — all in one machine. It vacuums carpets and hard floors with the power and intelligence of the V15 Detect, one of the most capable cordless vacuums ever made. And it washes hard floors using the Submarine wet roller head, removing spills, stains and everyday grime that vacuuming alone cannot reach. For homes in Pakistan where marble, tile and hard floor surfaces are the standard, this is the most relevant and capable home cleaning tool available today.

What Is the Submarine Wet Roller Head and How Does It Work

The Submarine wet roller head is the feature that separates the V15s from every other vacuum cleaner in Pakistan's market. The Submarine wet roller head removes spills and tough stains, using clean water from start to finish. The motorised wet roller picks up liquids, debris and tough stains, which are continuously extracted from the roller with each rotation. The Dyson Submarine wet roller head is engineered to absorb, extract and leave your floor with a streak-free finish.

The way it maintains clean water is the key engineering detail. The Submarine cleaner head covers over 1,000 square feet per tank of water. The full-width brush bar cleans edge to edge, manoeuvres easily around obstacles and reaches low under furniture. Dirty water is collected in a separate internal reservoir so the roller is always using fresh clean water, not spreading dirty water back across your floor the way a conventional mop does.

The Submarine head is excellent for tough dried-on stains, which is the real job of an electric mop. Spills that have dried and hardened on tile or marble floors are lifted by the motorised wet roller far more effectively than a manual mop or cloth can manage.

Three Cleaner Heads for Every Surface and Every Job

The V15s Detect Submarine comes with three distinct cleaner heads, each engineered for a specific cleaning purpose:

Digital Motorbar Cleaner Head — For Dry Vacuuming

The Digital Motorbar cleaner head is engineered for powerful suction on carpets and hard floors. It intelligently adapts power across floor types to deep clean carpets and hard floors. De-tangling vanes automatically clear wrapped hair from the brush bar as you clean. The de-tangling vanes are a particularly practical feature for Pakistani homes where long hair wrapping around brush bars is one of the most common maintenance frustrations with standard vacuums. The V15s eliminates that problem automatically during use.

Fluffy Optic Cleaner Head — For Hard Floor Precision

The Fluffy Optic cleaner head reveals microscopic dust on hard floors. Soft nylon and anti-static carbon fibre filaments capture dust from hard floors. A built-in laser illuminates fine dust particles on hard floors that are invisible to the naked eye, making them visible so you can target them and confirm they have been picked up. For marble and tile floors in Pakistani homes, where fine dust settles constantly and is notoriously hard to see until the light catches it at the right angle, this laser reveals exactly what needs cleaning and confirms when it has been cleaned.

Submarine Wet Roller Head — For Wet Floor Washing

Switch to the Submarine wet roller head when vacuuming is done and the floor needs washing. The 300ml clean water tank provides enough capacity to cover a full average-sized Pakistani home's hard floor area in a single pass. Clean water feeds the roller from the tank, dirty water is collected in a separate reservoir and the floor is left with a streak-free finish.

Key Features

Intelligent Suction Adaptation — Piezo Sensor and DLS Technology

The piezo sensor and Dyson DLS technology automatically sense debris level and floor type to adapt suction for the right balance of power and run time when you need it. On carpet, the machine increases suction. On hard floors, it adjusts to preserve battery. When it detects a concentration of debris, it boosts power automatically. You are not manually changing modes — the machine reads the floor and responds on its own.

LCD Screen — Scientific Proof of a Deep Clean

The LCD screen displays scientific proof of a deep clean. It calculates and categorises picked-up particles, showing you on-screen as you vacuum. It also displays run time countdown and power mode. For the first time, you do not need to guess whether your floors are clean. The screen counts the particles being collected and categorises them by size, giving you visible confirmation that the cleaning is working as you go.

Whole Machine Filtration — 99.99% of Particles Captured

Advanced whole machine filtration traps 99.99% of particles as small as 0.3 microns and expels cleaner air. Every particle the machine picks up is trapped inside the filtration system. The air expelled from the vacuum is cleaner than the air that entered it. For homes with allergy sufferers, children or anyone sensitive to dust and allergens, this level of filtration makes a genuine difference to indoor air quality during and after cleaning.

Anti-Tangle Technology

De-tangling vanes automatically clear wrapped hair from the brush bar as you clean. Long hair wrapping around vacuum brush bars is one of the most common reasons vacuums underperform over time. The V15s addresses this not as a maintenance task you do after cleaning, but as an automatic function that happens during cleaning. The brush bar stays clear throughout the session without you stopping to remove hair manually.

Hair Screw Tool

The innovative Hair screw tool picks up long hair and pet hair from surfaces without tangles. The conical brush bar shape means hair wraps in a single direction and can be removed cleanly at the end of a session rather than tangling into the bristles. For households with long hair and pets, this single tool removes one of the biggest frustrations from the vacuuming experience.

Converts to a Handheld

The V15s Detect Submarine converts to a handheld vacuum for cleaning up high, down low and everywhere in between — including your car. Detach the wand and use the body of the machine as a compact, powerful handheld for sofas, curtains, car seats, stairs and any surface that a floor vacuum cannot reach. One machine handles the entire home.

Wall Dok Charging and Storage

The Wall Dok is a wall-mounted dock to recharge the vacuum and tidily store tools. It charges your vacuum with or without the Wall Dok. The machine drops into the wall dock at the end of every clean, charges automatically and stores the tools within reach for the next session. The Submarine tray collects any water droplets from the wet roller head and stores the head between uses, keeping the dock clean and the head protected.

Why the V15s Detect Submarine Is the Right Choice for Pakistani Homes

Pakistani homes — particularly in Karachi, Lahore and other major cities — present specific cleaning challenges that no single conventional tool addresses well. Marble and tile floors are the standard, which means dust, sand and fine grit accumulate quickly and are difficult to see until they have already spread. Spills on hard floors need to be properly washed, not just wiped. Long hair from multiple family members wraps constantly around mop and vacuum heads. Dust in Pakistan is fine, persistent and returns quickly after cleaning.

The V15s Detect Submarine is the only machine available in Pakistan that vacuums, detects, adapts and washes in a single cordless device. It replaces a vacuum cleaner, a mop and a specialised hard floor sweeper simultaneously. It does the job of all three better than any individual tool does on its own.

Specifications

  • Model: V15s Detect Submarine
  • Type: Cordless wet and dry vacuum cleaner
  • Cleaner Heads: 3 (Digital Motorbar, Fluffy Optic, Submarine wet roller)
  • Water Tank: 300ml (covers over 1,000 sq ft per tank)
  • Filtration: 99.99% of particles as small as 0.3 microns
  • Display: LCD screen showing particles, run time and power mode
  • Intelligence: Piezo sensor and DLS automatic suction adaptation
  • Run Time: Up to 60 minutes (varies by mode and floor type)
  • Charging: Wall Dok wall-mounted charging dock included
  • Voltage: 220-240V (Pakistan compatible)
  • Best For: Hard floors, carpets, wet spills, whole-home cleaning

Frequently Asked Questions

What makes the V15s Detect Submarine different from a regular vacuum cleaner?

The V15s Detect Submarine deep cleans, detangles and washes — all in one machine. A regular vacuum cleaner only picks up dry debris. The V15s adds the Submarine wet roller head, which washes hard floors and removes spills and dried-on stains that vacuuming cannot address. It also adds the Fluffy Optic laser head that reveals invisible fine dust on hard floors. Three different cleaning functions in one cordless machine that a standard vacuum simply cannot match.

How does the Submarine wet roller head work?

The motorised wet roller picks up liquids, debris and tough stains, which are continuously extracted from the roller with each rotation. The Submarine wet roller head is engineered to absorb and extract and leave the floor with a streak-free finish. Clean water from the 300ml tank feeds the roller continuously. Dirty water collected from the floor goes into a separate internal reservoir so you are always mopping with clean water, not spreading dirty water back across your floor.

Can the Submarine wet roller head be used with older Dyson V15 models?

No. The Submarine wet roller head cannot be used with previous Dyson models, not even the previous V15. It is a programming compatibility issue, which is why Dyson does not sell the Submarine attachment separately — it only works with the V15s Submarine specifically. If you own an older V15, you would need to purchase the V15s Detect Submarine as a complete unit to access the wet roller functionality.

How much floor area can the Submarine head cover per tank?

The Submarine cleaner head covers over 1,000 square feet per tank of water. For context, most Pakistani apartments and homes fall comfortably within that range, meaning a full hard floor wash session in an average home can be completed on a single tank of water without refilling.

How does the laser on the Fluffy Optic head work?

The Fluffy Optic cleaner head has a built-in laser that shines across the hard floor surface at a low angle as you vacuum. This illuminates fine dust particles that are invisible to the naked eye under normal lighting. Soft nylon and anti-static carbon fibre filaments capture dust from hard floors. You can see exactly where the dust is and watch it being picked up, which gives you visible confirmation that the floor is genuinely clean rather than just appearing clean to casual inspection.

Does the V15s Detect really adapt suction automatically?

Yes. The piezo sensor and Dyson DLS technology automatically sense debris level and floor type to adapt suction for the right balance of power and run time when you need it. On carpet, suction increases. On hard floors, it moderates to save battery. When the sensor detects a high concentration of debris, it boosts power automatically to pick it all up. You do not need to change modes manually as you move between floor types.

What does the LCD screen show during vacuuming?

The LCD screen calculates and categorises picked-up particles, showing you on-screen as you vacuum. It also displays run time countdown and power mode. The particle count is categorised by size, giving you a real-time picture of what is being cleaned up. It also alerts you to any maintenance needs during operation.

How good is the filtration in the V15s Detect Submarine?

Advanced whole machine filtration traps 99.99% of particles as small as 0.3 microns and expels cleaner air. Every particle the machine picks up stays inside the filtration system. The air expelled from the machine is cleaner than the ambient air in your home. For households in Pakistan dealing with fine dust, construction particulates or family members with allergies, this level of filtration makes a meaningful difference to indoor air quality.

How does the de-tangling feature work for hair?

De-tangling vanes automatically clear wrapped hair from the brush bar as you clean. Rather than hair accumulating on the brush bar and reducing performance over time, the vanes actively clear it during operation. The Hair screw tool included with the machine also picks up long hair and pet hair from surfaces without tangles using a conical brush bar that prevents the tangling problem before it starts.

Dyson PencilVac Fluffycones Cordless Hard Floor Vacuum

The Dyson PencilVac Fluffycones is unlike any vacuum cleaner available in Pakistan today. At just 38mm in diameter — the same as Dyson's Supersonic r hair dryer — the PencilVac is the world's slimmest vacuum cleaner. It fits in your hand like a handle, weighs just 1.8kg and reaches places that no conventional vacuum cleaner can get to. And at its core is the brand new Fluffycones cleaner head — the only vacuum head in the world with four conical brush bars that eject long hair automatically, clean perfectly in every direction and reach right to the edge of every skirting board and wall.

This is not a vacuum for every cleaning task. The Dyson PencilVac is engineered to clean hard floors only. It is the right tool for daily quick cleans on marble, tile and hard floor surfaces — the kind of cleaning Pakistani homes need every single day. For deeper whole-home cleaning including carpets, the V15s Detect Submarine remains the right choice. But for fast, effortless, daily hard floor maintenance, the PencilVac Fluffycones does something no other vacuum in the market can match.

The Fluffycones Head — The Engineering Behind the Name

The cleaner head on the PencilVac Fluffycones is the most significant innovation in the product. The Fluffycones cleaner head has four conical brush bars in two brush bars, one behind the other, which rotate in opposite directions, causing the cleaner head to float across the floor and clean perfectly both forwards and backwards. The front brush bar cones rotate in one direction while the rear ones rotate in the opposite direction, cleaning brilliantly in all directions for added ease and efficiency.

The conical shape of each brush bar is the key to solving the biggest frustration with conventional vacuum brush bars — long hair tangling. When hair is picked up, it migrates to the end of the conical brush bars and is spiralled off into a hairball which can then be picked up by the cleaner head. Hair does not accumulate on the brush bar and reduce performance over time. It is actively ejected as you clean, every session, automatically.

The cones project at the edges, giving unparalleled cleaning right to the skirting board. Conventional vacuum heads have motors and housing that stop the brush bar short of the edge. The Fluffycones head has the cones protruding at both sides, meaning the cleaning surface reaches the very edge of the floor on every pass — the area closest to walls, skirting boards and furniture legs where dust collects most heavily and conventional vacuums consistently leave behind.

Dyson's Fastest Vacuum Motor in the World's Slimmest Body

A new Hyperdymium 140k motor had to be developed — Dyson's smallest and fastest vacuum motor to date — with a diameter of just 28mm, small enough to fit into the 38mm handle while being fast enough to generate powerful suction. It is 34% more power dense than its predecessor, spinning at up to 140,000 RPM to generate 55 air watts of suction. The engineering challenge of fitting a genuinely powerful motor into a body smaller than most people's wrists, without compromising suction, is what took Dyson years to develop. The result is a vacuum that feels impossibly light but performs with genuine power.

Key Features

Dual Green Lasers — Dust Visible in All Directions

Four conical brush bars remove long hair without tangling and clean right to the edge, removing more dust than any other vacuum. Dust and dirt is illuminated in all directions so you do not miss a thing. Unlike the single forward-facing laser on other Dyson heads, the PencilVac Fluffycones has laser illumination both in front of and behind the cleaner head. Fine dust particles that are invisible to the naked eye are revealed in real time as you clean, and you can see in both directions whether the floor has been properly cleaned. For marble and tile floors in Pakistani homes where fine dust is a constant presence and hard to see, this dual illumination makes every clean more thorough and more verifiable.

Flattens to Clean Under Furniture

The new slim format enables the PencilVac to lay flat on the ground, flattening to just 95mm to clean under low furniture. The Fluffycones cleaner head flattens to a height of just 3.75 inches to fit under sofas. Low-profile sofas, beds and storage furniture that conventional vacuums cannot reach underneath are no longer obstacles. The slim format of the PencilVac handles them all without moving a single piece of furniture.

Spins on the Spot for Maximum Manoeuvrability

The Fluffycones cleaner head spins on the spot to make it easier to clean hard floors all around the home. Cleaning around chair legs, table bases, plant pots and furniture clusters requires a head that can turn tightly in any direction without you having to reposition yourself or the furniture. The counter-rotating cone design allows the head to move laterally, spin, reverse and clean sideways — cleaning patterns that no conventional straight-running vacuum head can achieve.

Two-Stage Fully Sealed Filtration

Dyson's top-loading bin is engineered with a two-stage fully-sealed filtration system that captures 99.99% of microscopic particles with no loss of suction. Specifically designed for the ultra-slim format. Every particle collected by the PencilVac stays inside the filtration system. The air expelled is clean. For Pakistani homes dealing with fine construction dust, sand, allergens or daily outdoor particulates brought in through doors and windows, this level of filtration makes a real difference to the indoor air quality while you clean.

Hygienic Syringe-Action Bin Emptying

Dyson's new bin emptying system reduces dust clouds by pushing compressed dust deep into your bin. For more hygienic emptying. Rather than opening a flap and shaking the bin over a dustbin — which releases dust clouds back into the air — the PencilVac uses a syringe-style mechanism that plunges compressed dust out cleanly. You do not need to touch the dust and you do not create a cloud of it during disposal.

Magnetic Charging Dock

The magnetic charging dock conveniently stores the machine and accessories for quick grab-and-go access. Drop the PencilVac onto the magnetic dock at the end of every use and it charges automatically. The dock keeps the machine upright, accessible and charged at all times. For a vacuum designed for daily quick cleans, the ability to grab it and go without thinking about charging is a practical benefit that makes a difference to whether the machine actually gets used every day.

Swappable Click-In Battery

The battery detaches with one click, without screws. So it is easy to remove and replace. The PencilVac runs for up to 30 minutes in Eco mode. Additional click-in batteries are available to provide even longer cleans. For larger homes that need more than 30 minutes of daily floor cleaning, a second battery extends the run time without needing to return to the dock. The single-click removal means swapping batteries between rooms is fast and requires no tools.

MyDyson App Connected

The PencilVac is Dyson's first connected cordless vacuum. It connects to the MyDyson app for real-time battery and maintenance alerts, including filter cleaning guidance. The app tells you when the filter needs cleaning, provides maintenance guides and connects you to Dyson support if anything needs attention. Filter cleaning reminders ensure the machine maintains its suction performance over the long term without you having to track it manually.

Why the PencilVac Fluffycones Is Perfect for Pakistani Homes

Pakistani homes — particularly urban apartments and homes in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad — have hard floors throughout. Marble, tile, cement and porcelain are the standard. These surfaces show fine dust, sand, hair and debris quickly and require daily cleaning to stay presentable. The conventional approach is a broom, a dustpan and a bucket mop. The broom scatters fine dust. The mop spreads dirty water. Neither removes fine particles from the surface properly.

The PencilVac Fluffycones is built specifically for this daily hard floor cleaning challenge. It is slim enough to store in any home without taking up space. It is light enough to use for a quick clean without it feeling like a chore. Its Fluffycones head cleans right to every edge, in every direction, without you moving furniture. Its lasers reveal the fine dust that a broom cannot even collect. And its filtration keeps that dust inside the machine rather than redistributing it into the air as a broom does.

Specifications

  • Model: PencilVac Fluffycones
  • Diameter: 38mm (world's slimmest vacuum)
  • Total Weight: 1.8kg (3.9 lbs)
  • Handheld Weight: 0.77kg (1.7 lbs)
  • Motor: Dyson Hyperdymium 140k, up to 140,000 RPM
  • Suction: 50-55 Air Watts
  • Run Time: Up to 30 minutes (Eco mode)
  • Filtration: 99.99% of particles as small as 0.3 microns
  • Cleaner Head: Fluffycones with four conical brush bars
  • Illumination: Dual green lasers, front and rear
  • Connectivity: MyDyson app via Bluetooth
  • Charging: Magnetic charging dock
  • Best For: Hard floors only — marble, tile, porcelain, wood

Both models feature the same slim 38mm format and are powered by the Dyson Hyperdymium 140k motor. The PencilVac Fluffycones adds a cleaner head with four conical brush bars that prevent hair from tangling and allows for unparalleled edge-to-edge cleaning. Dyson V16 Piston Animal Submarine Wet and Dry Vacuum Cleaner

The Dyson V16 Piston Animal Submarine is the most powerful, most intelligent and most capable cordless vacuum Dyson has ever built. The V16 Piston Animal is the most powerful anti-tangle cordless vacuum with up to 315AW of fade-free suction power. It vacuums carpets and hard floors, washes hard floors with the upgraded Submarine 2.0 wet roller head, detangles pet and human hair automatically, compresses dust so the bin only needs emptying once a month, and monitors dust levels 15,000 times per second to optimise suction without wasting battery. This is the vacuum for Pakistani homes that want one machine to do everything, and do it better than anything else available.

How the V16 Piston Animal Submarine Differs From the V15s Detect Submarine

Both machines are wet and dry vacuums. Both include the Submarine wet roller head. But the V16 represents a meaningful upgrade across every key dimension:

  • Suction: The V16 delivers 315AW compared to 240AW on the V15s — 31% more suction power from Dyson's new Hyperdymium 900W motor
  • Motor: The Hyperdymium 900W is Dyson's most powerful vacuum motor ever built
  • Wet roller: The Submarine 2.0 on the V16 adds a new Max mode for targeting tougher stains
  • Filtration: Five-stage HEPA filtration capturing particles as small as 0.1 microns on the V16, compared to 0.3 microns on the V15s
  • Bin: The CleanCompaktor bin holds up to 30 days of dust — 3x the capacity of the V15 bin
  • Run time: Up to 70 minutes on the V16 versus 60 minutes on the V15s
  • Cleaner head: The All Floor Cones Sense head on the V16 has two conical brush bars for anti-tangle on both carpets and hard floors
  • Dust sensing: 15,000 readings per second on the V16 for real-time suction optimisation

If you want the very best cordless vacuum available in Pakistan today — for whole-home cleaning including pets, hard floors and wet spills — the V16 Piston Animal Submarine is the one to buy.

315AW — What That Actually Means

The Dyson V16 Piston Animal Submarine is powered by Dyson's latest Hyperdymium 900W digital motor — enhanced and smaller with greater efficiency — delivering up to 315AW of fade-free suction power. Air Watts is the correct way to measure vacuum performance because it accounts for both airflow and suction together, not just one or the other. 315AW is more suction than any other cordless vacuum available at any price point from any brand. For Pakistani homes where heavy dust, sand, pet hair and debris accumulate quickly on marble and tile floors, this level of suction picks up everything in fewer passes with less effort.

Key Features

All Floor Cones Sense Cleaner Head — Anti-Tangle on Every Surface

The All Floor Cones Sense cleaner head has two conical brush bars engineered to remove and de-tangle pet hair and long hair from carpets and hard floors. The cleaner head auto-adjusts between floors for whole-home cleaning. The conical shape of the brush bars means hair migrates to the tip rather than accumulating and wrapping around the bar. It is the same principle as the PencilVac Fluffycones but on a full-size, high-suction whole-home cleaner head. For homes with long-haired family members or pets, this head eliminates the most common frustration with standard vacuums — having to manually remove tangled hair from the brush bar after every session.

Submarine 2.0 Wet Roller Head — Wet Cleaning Upgraded

The Submarine 2.0 wet roller head removes dirt from hard floors and targets stubborn stains. Its motorised microfibre roller washes spills and stains from hard floors, with a new Max mode to wash away even tougher stains. The Max mode is new to the V16 and not available on the V15s Submarine head. For dried spills, food residue and stubborn grime on tile and marble floors in Pakistani homes, this higher intensity wash mode provides more effective stain removal than the previous generation. Clean water from the tank feeds the roller throughout, dirty water is extracted into a separate reservoir and the floor is left with a streak-free finish.

CleanCompaktor Bin — 30 Days Before Emptying

The Dyson CleanCompaktor bin compresses dust and hair in the bin and wipes clean for hygienic emptying. The bin capacity is 1.35L — compresses to hold 3 times more dust and debris than the bin size, holding up to 30 days worth of dust for bigger bin capacity. The compression mechanism means the bin rarely needs emptying. For busy households in Pakistan where daily cleaning is essential but frequent bin maintenance is inconvenient, the ability to clean for a full month without touching the bin is a meaningful practical improvement over standard vacuum bins that need emptying after every few sessions.

Dust Detect Sensor — 15,000 Readings Per Second

The dust detect sensor monitors dust levels in real time, up to 15,000 readings per second, to optimise suction and battery life. The machine is continuously reading the debris level it encounters and adjusting suction automatically. When it detects a high concentration of dust or debris, suction increases. When the floor is clean, it moderates to preserve battery. You are always getting the right amount of power for what is actually on the floor, which means less battery waste and more consistent results across every surface in your home.

Five-Stage HEPA Filtration — 0.1 Micron Particles

The fully-sealed, five-stage filtration system captures 99.99% of particles as small as 0.1 microns — the size of allergens, bacteria and viruses. This is a step beyond the V15s's filtration, which captures down to 0.3 microns. Particles at 0.1 microns include bacteria, virus-sized particles and the finest allergens. Every particle collected stays inside the sealed filtration system and the air expelled is cleaner than the ambient air in your home. For Pakistani households with allergy sufferers, young children or anyone concerned about indoor air quality, this level of filtration makes a genuine and measurable difference.

Hidden Built-In Tools

The Dyson V16 Piston Animal features hidden built-in tools for convenient switching between tasks. Two built-in tools provide quick cleans up high and down low. You can quickly switch between tasks, instantly releasing and attaching the cleaner head without bending down. The built-in crevice tool is accessible within the wand itself — no searching for attachments in a dock or case. For cleaning along skirting boards, inside wardrobes or under appliances, having the crevice tool immediately available makes the switch between floor vacuuming and detailed cleaning seamless.

Hair Screw Tool 2.0 — Pet and Upholstery Cleaning

The Hair screw tool 2.0 has a motorised conical brush bar that removes and de-tangles stubborn hair from pet beds, cars and stairs. It has an additional rubber strip to agitate deeper into carpets and increase front edge cleaning, and rug strips to stop stalling on soft furnishings such as cushions. For Pakistani homes with pets, or where long hair accumulates on fabric sofas, car seats and bed surfaces, this tool handles the kind of embedded hair that a standard vacuum attachment cannot shift.

Intelligent Tool Detection

Your vacuum detects the tool you are using and automatically adapts suction to give you more power when you need it and conserves energy when you do not. Switch from the main cleaner head to the hair screw tool on a sofa and the machine automatically adjusts its suction output for the new surface and task. You are never manually changing power modes between attachments.

Up to 70 Minutes Run Time With Swappable Battery

The run time is up to 70 minutes of powerful, fade-free suction. The battery is removable and swappable — it detaches without screws for easy removal and replacement. For larger homes that need more than 70 minutes of cleaning, a second battery extends the session without a break. The swappable design also means that as the battery ages over years of use, it can be replaced independently rather than the whole machine needing replacement.

LCD Screen for Real-Time Feedback

The LCD screen displays captured particles, dirt and dust for scientific proof of a deep clean. It also shows run time countdown and power mode. Particle counts categorised by size appear on screen as you vacuum, giving you visible confirmation that each area of the floor has been thoroughly cleaned. Run time remaining is visible throughout so you never run out of battery unexpectedly mid-clean.

MyDyson App Connected

The MyDyson app enables access to cleaning analysis, advice on machine performance and personalised settings. The V16 is Dyson's first app-connected cordless vacuum. The app provides maintenance alerts, filter cleaning reminders and cleaning analysis so you can track the performance of the machine and maintain it properly over time.
